name: Zovo DOCX
description: Create, read and edit .docx documents including paragraphs, tables and styling. Hosted remote MCP server (streamable HTTP) with a focused tool set; runs at https://mcp.zovo.one/mcp/docx. A free access token can be minted at https://mcp.zovo.one/mcp/connect and passed as an Authorization: Bearer header for tool calls; listing tools works anonymously. Source: https://github.com/theluckystrike/mcp-servers. Also available on npm as @theluckystrike/mcp-docx.
